config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-18: CQL - List Operators Part 1. Test these items: Contains(list, element); Distinct(list); Equal (List); Equivalent (List); Except (List); Exists(list); Flatten(list); First(list); In(element, list); Includes(list); Included In (list); IndexOf(list, element); Intersect (List). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. Do not inspect or rely on archived prior workflow outputs as proof; use current source, specs, current tests, and fresh probes. When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.summary: CQL Except list set semantics now de-duplicate and preserve first-occurrence order.
CQL Intersect list set semantics now retain one null when both operands contain null.
CQL list membership, set, equality, and IndexOf helpers now compare compatible Quantity values through quantityCompare.
